description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for '/metrics/stats' and '/metrics/activity' endpoints, handling retrieval of metric statistics and activity feeds, with security via authRequired middleware, and interacts with Metric and Activity models.

methods.name: GET /metrics/stats
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /metrics/stats, returning aggregated metric statistics including count, total, average, and latest entries.

methods.name: GET /metrics/activity
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /metrics/activity, returning recent user activity records.
